products.name: Descript Overdub
products.note: Voice cloning for editing; consent recording required; deepfake risk; media integrity

profile_text.body:
Descript is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an AI video and audio editor built around a text-based editing model: users record or upload footage, the platform transcribes it automatically, and edits to the transcript, such as deleting a word or moving a sentence, apply directly to the underlying video or audio. The company positions this approach as making video editing as straightforward as editing a document.

Descript offers two tracked AI products. The first is its core editor, which handles recording, transcription, editing, and publishing in a single tool. The second is Overdub, a voice cloning feature that requires a consent recording and carries noted considerations around deepfake risk and media integrity. The platform also includes an AI editing assistant called Underlord, which the company describes as capable of turning a raw recording into a finished cut in minutes, and tools for automatically generating short clips from longer video or podcast content.

The held facts note 174 entries of California legal exposure associated with the company, though no specific litigation cases are currently recorded in the site's database.
